headline: Saudi Private-Sector Agricultural Investments Exceed SR60 Billion
summary: Saudi Deputy Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture Eng. Mansour Al-Mushaiti stated that private-sector investments in the agricultural sector have surpassed SR60 billion, supported by Agricultural Development Fund loans.
why: Agricultural development financing and private-sector capital deployment are key pillars for enhancing national food security and economic diversification goals.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Private agricultural investments support domestic food security and economic output.
